# OpenAVC v0.37.0-rc2

A second preview of 0.37.0, with the fixes found since the first. Its main change is a new setting, Settings > Network > Accept connections from, which chooses whether touch panels and browsers can reach OpenAVC from any network, from one network adapter, or from this computer only. The full notes come with 0.37.0.

## About this preview

This is a preview release for a last check of 0.37.0 on each kind of install before the release. It is not offered to systems on the stable update channel.
